'''CardMaker recreation''' of version PC-E1 of [[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V)]]: the PC website card-list text, shown there by 21 July 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html VBlock8Type, 2012-07-21], Internet Archive): “Deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force drain where present. During battle, Mara may use a blaster and this weapon. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-marajadeslightsaber-pre.gif]]) prints the same words, but it is its own version (PC-E3, uploaded 7 May 2013, the current text; [[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V) (Errata 3)]]); the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p5-26-Mara_Jades_Lightsaber.png]]) and the Master List print the original text. Made 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card. Not an official image.
